description_en: Switches a production studio to the standby resource
name: EffectCasterUrgent

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio.

If you created a production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, use the returned CasterId value.

If you created a production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to the Production Studio > Cloud Production Studio page to obtain the ID.

The name of the production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。
如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台页面查看。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the scene. This parameter is valid only for PGM scenes.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848039.html operation to query the scene ID of the production studio
parameters.help_zh:
场景ID，PGM场景时有效。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848039.html接口查询导播台场景ID
parameters.name: scene_id
